title: Constant current charge relation
description: Essential: The response must correctly state that the capacitor voltage is U1 = It / C.

title: KVL application
description: Essential: The response must correctly state that the capacitor voltage is U2 = U - I2R.

title: Charge accumulation reasoning
description: Important: The solution should link constant current to accumulated charge Q = It.

title: Ohm's Law on resistor
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must calculate the resistor voltage as I2R.

title: Circuit stage understanding
description: Optional: The response may correctly identify the constant-current and constant-voltage stages.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final answers may be presented with correct implied units (volts).

title: Sign error in KVL
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly writing U2 = U + I2R or U2 = I2R - U.

title: Confusing capacitance formula
description: Pitfall: Using U1 = I t C instead of U1 = (I t) / C.
